risk_score.rationale: The alert score is elevated (70) and includes multiple corroborating IOCs—suspicious splunkd.exe execution from Public, evasive PowerShell, and HTTP download activity to an internal host on port 8888—making malicious initiation and recurrence highly likely with a strong chance of host compromise and operational impact.

incident_details.title: High Risk Alerts: NetWitness Endpoint for KELLYWANG
incident_details.description: This alert shows suspicious endpoint activity involving a masquerading executable named splunkd.exe launched from Public, along with hidden PowerShell using ExecutionPolicy Bypass and a network download pattern to an internal host on port 8888. The combination of unusual process behavior, suspicious command lines, and internal HTTP communication indicates likely host compromise or unauthorized execution, but there is no clear evidence of active destructive impact or widespread outbreak.
